text:
The dish is a small white bowl, roughly 15 cm across at the rim. It holds sliced strawberries, blackberries and sliced almonds. There may be yogurt underneath, but I can't see any.

For the fruit, I estimate about 60 g of strawberries and 60 g of blackberries. That comes to about 20 kcal for the strawberries and 26 kcal for the blackberries.

The almonds look like about 15 g, which is roughly 85 kcal.

If there is yogurt hidden under the fruit, it could add around 100 g and 60-100 kcal. Since I can't confirm it, I'll count only part of it.

Fruit and almonds alone total about 135 g and 130 kcal. Adding a possible partial yogurt layer brings the estimate to about 180 g and 190 kcal.
